name: Separable Convolution for Volume Reconstruction and Differentiation
aliases: Separable Reconstruction and Differentiation via 1D Kernel Product
definition: A technique to compute 3D reconstruction and derivatives by treating each dimension of the image in isolation, using a 3D kernel generated as the product of three 1D kernels.
summary: Separable Convolution for Volume Reconstruction and Differentiation computes 3D volume reconstruction and spatial derivatives by decomposing the operation into a product of three 1D kernels, reducing computational complexity compared to direct 3D convolution.
